speaker: Pablo Cagnoni

Importantly, for the crossover patients, the number of responders increased from 58 to 100 in just six weeks, demonstrating once again the rapid onset of benefit produced by Povorcitinib in patients with HS. speaker: Pablo Cagnoni
title: EVP and Head of R&D at Incyte Corporation
